sender: The Superior Court Jury Services Office (Valley Crest Judicial District)
headline: This is a jury duty summons. You must respond before {{DATE:+10}}.
summary: The court picked you at random to serve on a jury. You need to go to the courthouse on {{DATE:+10}} at 7:45 AM, unless you ask to postpone or be excused. Before that day, you must answer this summons online or by phone. Your job cannot fire you for going.

deadline.what_is_due: Respond to the summons, then report to the courthouse at 7:45 AM.

if_ignored: If you don't respond or don't show up, the court can fine you up to $1,500 and order you to come to a hearing to explain why. It's much easier to respond now, even if you need to ask for a later date.

action_steps.title: Respond online or by phone
action_steps.detail: Go to the jury website and enter your Juror ID JX-302-8817. Confirm you can come, or ask for a postponement if the date doesn't work.

action_steps.title: Or call the jury office
action_steps.detail: They answer Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. Tell them if you need an interpreter or a disability accommodation.

action_steps.title: Check the night before
action_steps.detail: After 5:00 PM on the business day before {{DATE:+10}}, call or check the website to see if you still need to come in.

action_steps.title: Go to the courthouse
action_steps.detail: Be there at 7:45 AM. Bring this summons and a photo ID. Park in Lot B.

red_flags.text: Real courts never ask for payment, gift cards or your bank details by phone for jury duty. If anyone calls asking for money about this summons, hang up.

reasons: It has a juror ID, a courthouse address and normal ways to respond.
It does not ask for money, your Social Security number or bank details.
To be extra safe, call the court using the number on the court's official website.
